name: No Take, Only Throw
look: A three-panel black-and-white doodle comic of a floppy-eared dog wearing a collar with a tag. In the first panel it looks hopeful, in the second a human hand reaches toward it and it scowls, and in the third it glares up close.
use: Based on a dog that begs you to throw its toy but will not let you take it. Captions show someone who wants a result but refuses to hand over what is needed: panel one asks, panel two refuses, panel three insists.
slots: panel 2: the refusal when someone reaches in
